description: Check transfer and one-way playlist-sync capabilities between two platforms, including Soundiiz storage. Use public slugs, such as spotify and youtube-music, or existing Soundiiz corenames such as ytmusic and soundiiz. Return supported item types and human-readable web guide URLs from the cached platform catalog or configured Soundiiz storage capabilities. Show the exact returned guideUrl links, including query parameters, to users. This does not check account eligibility or live status. Results always use canonical public slugs.

destination.description: Destination public slug, for example youtube-music, or soundiiz for Soundiiz storage. Existing Soundiiz corenames, such as ytmusic, are also accepted.

source.description: Source public slug from https://soundiiz.com/capabilities.json, or soundiiz for Soundiiz storage. Existing Soundiiz corenames are also accepted; not a URL.

name: getSoundiizTransferCompatibility

generatedAt.description: Generation time of the cached capability snapshot in UTC.

guideUrl.description: Public web guide to show as a clickable link to the user; null when no guide is published.
